graphs.title: Context | Student Exchange
graphs.scope: Entire implemented system, with preview and listing limitations stated
graphs.note: One system process, external entities and boundary data only. Internal stores do not appear.

graphs.title: Level-0 | Student Exchange data flows
graphs.scope: Website, Node adapter, backend and logical storage
graphs.note: Grouped stores are expanded into named primitive stores below. Listing API access is independent of the website.

graphs.title: 1.0 | Marketplace preview data
graphs.source: Website/src/App.tsx: visibleListings and message/offer handlers; src/data/listings.ts
graphs.note: D1 is bundled sample data. D2 is one App-level array, not a per-listing persisted conversation.

graphs.title: 2.0 | Accounts and website sessions
graphs.source: Website/server/api.mjs: account routes; Backend/Register.cs, LogIn.cs, Schools.cs
graphs.note: Shared access flows contain an operation discriminator; parallel-looking arrows represent alternative requests, not execution order.

graphs.title: 3.0 | Administration data
graphs.source: Website/server/admin.mjs, api.mjs; Backend/Admin.cs, Register.cs, Schools.cs, Blocked.cs, Users.cs
graphs.note: Fresh membership data qualifies every operation. Target rank/lock checks remain enforced by backend auth.

graphs.title: 4.0 | Access and forwarding data
graphs.source: Website/server/api.mjs: forwarding client, upstream; Backend/AppAuthJson.cs, Users.cs, IP.cs
graphs.note: This logical transformation spans the Node adapter and backend helpers; it is not a separate deployed service.

graphs.title: 5.0 | Retained security data maintenance
graphs.note: Timing is a process specification, not a data-flow arrow: asynchronous startup cleanup and daily 03:24 Mountain work.

graphs.title: 6.0 | Direct listing API data
graphs.note: Direct API client only. No website listing adapter route, shared auth/ownership checks or supplied Listings DDL.

graphs.title: 2.1 | Registration data transformation
graphs.source: Website/server/api.mjs: account routes; Backend/Register.cs, LogIn.cs, Schools.cs
graphs.note: Registration does not issue an access token or create a website session.

graphs.title: 2.2 | Login token and cookie data
graphs.source: Website/server/api.mjs: account routes; Backend/Register.cs, LogIn.cs, Schools.cs
graphs.note: Backend token lifetime: 21 days, or 3 for admins. Website session: fixed 12 hours. Browser sees only an opaque ID.

graphs.title: 2.4 | Saved profile and readback data
graphs.source: Website/server/api.mjs: account routes; Backend/Register.cs, LogIn.cs, Schools.cs
graphs.note: A committed write plus failed readback yields a saved notice and null profile; it does not imply a failed write.

graphs.title: 2.5 | Logout and revocation data
graphs.source: Website/server/api.mjs: account routes; Backend/Register.cs, LogIn.cs, Schools.cs
graphs.note: Backend 200 can mask token-validation failure. A confirmation is not evidence that target tokens existed or were deleted.

graphs.title: 3.2 | Target user record management
graphs.source: Website/server/admin.mjs, api.mjs; Backend/Admin.cs, Register.cs, Schools.cs, Blocked.cs, Users.cs
graphs.note: Caller access_token remains the admin token. to_user selects the target and must match the stored normalized email exactly.

graphs.title: 3.4 | Admin membership changes
graphs.source: Website/server/admin.mjs, api.mjs; Backend/Admin.cs, Register.cs, Schools.cs, Blocked.cs, Users.cs
graphs.note: Admin management needs caller level > 0; explicitly setting locked needs level ≥ 30. Target admins must have lower rank.

graphs.title: 3.5 | Attempt inspection and clearing
graphs.source: Website/server/admin.mjs, api.mjs; Backend/Admin.cs, Register.cs, Schools.cs, Blocked.cs, Users.cs
graphs.note: Rows include observations below the block threshold; clearing records does not recreate revoked access tokens.

graphs.title: 4.2 | Forwarding identity data
graphs.source: Website/server/api.mjs: forwarding client, upstream; Backend/AppAuthJson.cs, Users.cs, IP.cs
graphs.note: Service admin_token and visitor access_token are different data. Only explicit forwarding-expiry rejection permits one renewal retry.

graphs.title: 4.3 | Application and IP observations
graphs.source: Website/server/api.mjs: forwarding client, upstream; Backend/AppAuthJson.cs, Users.cs, IP.cs
graphs.note: IP rows contain encrypted addresses. Forwarded-IP trust is server-owned; browser fields cannot replace the security envelope.

graphs.title: 4.4 | User identity and attempt observations
graphs.source: Website/server/api.mjs: forwarding client, upstream; Backend/AppAuthJson.cs, Users.cs, IP.cs
graphs.note: Attempt blocking is applied to login admission; ordinary token validation does not itself consult Blocked_Users.
